def evolved_llama_block(attn_partial, mlp_partial, rank, world_size,
                        num_devices, cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # Formula: return AR-summed attn and mlp. Fuse into ONE all_reduce.
    combined = torch.cat([attn_partial, mlp_partial], dim=-1)
    reduced = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, combined)
    dm = attn_partial.shape[-1]
    return [reduced[..., :dm], reduced[..., dm:]]
